headline: Happiest Minds reports 15% profit rise and announces interim dividend
hook: IT player posts mid-single earnings growth
summary: Happiest Minds Technologies reported a 15.12% increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 62 crore for the quarter ended September. Revenue from operations grew 12.5% year-on-year to Rs 645 crore. The company declared an interim dividend of Rs 3.05 per share for the 2026-27 fiscal year. Results also included an exceptional charge stemming from a proposed merger with ITC Infotech. Indian retail shareholders of Happiest Minds receive both steady earnings expansion and an interim payout.
whats_next: Next quarterly results and merger developments
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers reflect steady tech spending and provide an interim cash payout.
